headline: Israeli fire kills 4 Palestinians in Gaza in 24 hours
dek: Israeli fire killed 4 Palestinians and wounded 10 across Gaza in a 24-hour period: a drone strike on al-Mawasi (west of Khan Younis) killed 1 man and wounded 5 (incl. a woman and two girls); a strike on Khan Younis killed 1 and wounded 4 (one critically); a man died of wounds from a…
sources: Medical officials at Nasser Medical Complex, via Anadolu Agency relayed by Yeni Safak
fault_line: Ceasefire in name only vs targeted strikes on militants: is every new Gaza death proof the ceasefire is dead, or does the toll keep rising inside a 'ceasefire' both sides still claim?

sections.what_happened: Israeli fire killed 4 Palestinians and wounded 10 across Gaza in a 24-hour period: a drone strike on al-Mawasi (west of Khan Younis) killed 1 man and wounded 5 (incl. a woman and two girls); a strike on Khan Younis killed 1 and wounded 4 (one critically); a man died of wounds from a Sunday-afternoon al-Mawasi strike, bringing the period total to 4. Gaza Health Ministry ceasefire-period toll cited as 1,583 killed and 5,711 wounded since Oct 10, 2025. Distinct from the Reuters Monday count of 3 killed (recorded 1200-04): different reporting window and source count, not a contradiction.
sections.what_verified: Anadolu Agency reporting of Nasser Medical Complex officials, relayed by Yeni Safak.
sections.what_disputed: Reuters Monday wire (recorded 1200-04) counted 3 killed in Khan Younis/Al-Mussadar airstrikes with 6 wounded and a 1,580 ceasefire-period toll — a different incident set/window, so the two counts are not directly comparable; neither piece carries an Israeli comment on the specific strikes.
sections.why_matters: 4 more killed in Gaza in 24 hours — the ceasefire-period toll hits 1,583, and the 'ceasefire' keeps counting bodies.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Yeni Safak 12:02+03 = 13:02 ) -- Israeli fire kills 4 Palestinians in Gaza in 24 hours; ceasefire-period toll now 1,583

totw_analysis: Our read: 4 more killed in Gaza in 24 hours — the ceasefire-period toll hits 1,583, and the 'ceasefire' keeps counting bodies. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Ceasefire in name only vs targeted strikes on militants: is every new Gaza death proof the ceasefire is dead, or does the toll keep rising inside a 'ceasefire' both sides still claim?
